review_scope.method: Fresh review against content.json brief and preserve boundaries, supplied READY coverage log, direct view_image inspection of each of the 12 rendered page PNGs, and PDF page-size/hash inspection. No GUI, CAD edits or PDF regeneration performed.
review_scope.limitations: Review verifies the booklet presentation and consistency with supplied brief. It does not independently reopen native CAD, verify reload of dimensions, audit all component IDs across STEP/CAD/web, reproduce BRep sections, or establish hardware manufacturing accuracy.

acceptance_results.automated_delivery: READY: 0 errors, 1 warning, 0 data gaps; content coverage, fonts, density and page contract OK in supplied log.
acceptance_results.visual: All 12 pages inspected. No clipped content, text/figure overlap, stranded headings, fallback boxes, or blocking unreadability observed. Figure captions and dimensions remain visible.
acceptance_results.preserve: CECHA00, 60 GB, arched crown, four USB and card-reader description, early motorless SIXAXIS and separate three-wire sensor, four original cable groups, grounding tail, short display cables and nonfunctional approximation limits are retained in visible drawings/text.
acceptance_results.counts: 1592 component entries and 1676 solids remain distinct on pages 1 and 11; 30 source stages and both counts also appear on page 12.
acceptance_results.native_geometry: CAD-derived views and physical sections are stated and presented; underlying generation and native dimension reload are outside this isolated visual review.

findings.finding: Several middle layers remain visually dense in the exploded projection, so individual internal components are easier to understand using the dedicated sheets. This does not obscure captions or cause page clipping; it is nonblocking for the stated study-booklet scope.
Headings identified in the supplied log remain at page tops or in intact table headers, with their associated content present. Visual inspection found no stranded heading on these pages.
